paragraphs.text: Strixhaven Stadium is a large sports arena on the Central Campus of Strixhaven University on the plane of Arcavios . It is the primary venue for major Mage Tower events, most notably the Battle of Strixhaven .

Constructed less than a century ago, Strixhaven Stadium stands as a grand testament to the university's prestige and tradition. It hosts major Mage Tower matches, including the celebrated Battle of Strixhaven , an event held only once every three years.

The vast, circular field is bright green and dotted with small hills, with forty-foot towers at each end and bleachers that rise fifty feet high. Five spires display the flags of the university's colleges, while a sixth bears the Strixhaven star. The uneven terrain makes the entire field difficult to cross, encouraging players to rely on flight and other magical movement as they attempt to capture the opposing team's mascot. The stands are packed with hundreds of cheering students and faculty.

Two locker rooms serve the stadium — one at the north end of the field and the other at the south. Each room contains rows of lockers, along with racks of uniforms and field gear. Before games, teams and their mascots are supposed to stay inside their respective locker rooms, waiting until they are called onto the field before they can throw sarcastic remarks at the opposing team's members.
